newsitem.title: UK: GA launches 3 mln stg advertising campaign.
newsitem.headline: GA launches 3 mln stg advertising campaign.

text.p: Insurer General Accident said it would be running a nation-wide TV and press campaign to promote its pension policies.
The campaign, developed with the insurer's advertising agency Publicis, will run through October and November.

"General Accident is a very familiar name. But the company wants to increase its profile in the retirement planning and investment arenas," Ian Bullock, retail marketing manager at General Accident Life, said in a statement.
